basis: The about page names the Verein Kunsthalle Zürich as the institution's governing body, and the 2025 annual report presents the accounts of that association.
The Kunsthaus organisation page says the Zürcher Kunstgesellschaft, an art association, oversees the museum and that its board appoints the Director.

The Migros Commitment organisation page places the museum in the Culture Unit of the Social Commitment Directorate of the Federation of Migros Cooperatives, and the museum's facts and figures sheet says the Federation carries it; it is a unit of a cooperative, recorded here as a private company.
Section 1 of the statutes of 29 June 2023 makes Shedhalle an association under Article 60 of the Swiss Civil Code, and section 4.4 says the board employs the management and curatorial team.
The Directorate's about page says it is a scientific body linked to the Minister of Culture, and its national museums page says it manages the national museums including the Damascus National Museum.

red_tape.note: The Kaohsiung City Government told the city council in May 2025 that, while the museum and two sister museums ran as city agencies, rigid hierarchy, accounting rules and budget rules kept them from hiring suitable specialists and from carrying out building repairs in time.

basis: Governance: pages 5 to 6 and 119 of the city government's May 2025 report to the council describe the administrative corporation Kaohsiung Professional Cultural Institution, a public legal person set up in 2017, and its civil servant and professional staff counts. Red tape: page 4 of the same report.

The museum's about page says the sculptor Ju Ming founded the museum and the foundation, and its organisation page lists the board of the Ju Ming Culture and Education Foundation, which runs the museum website.
Article 1 of the Organization Act of the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, promulgated 29 June 2011, says the Ministry of Culture set up the museum.

The 2025 final accounts report says the museum is an administrative corporation under the Tainan Art Museum Establishment Ordinance in force from 9 February 2017, lists its staff on page 44, and its appendix reports the Tainan City Council's conditions on its budget.
The foundation page says the entrepreneur Chew Tsai-hsing founded the foundation in 1991 and that the foundation founded the museum in 1999.
